owner: CC builds; Akien owns whether a boat riding a superseded intention is ended or re-parented.
children: 44 in-flight tickets carry no owning_intention (measured 2026-08-18, against 28 that do; 64 closed tickets also lack it and are out of scope — a review of what is RIDING does not care about landed boats). NOT CAST: the backfill needs a per-ticket judgement about which intention actually owns each boat, and several of the 44 may honestly have none, which is a question for the corpus rather than a chore for a script. THIS NODE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DEPEND ON IT — see design_choice below.

watchme.trigger: every supersession of an intention — the act of writing the supersession field to a charter. Fires on the act; no clock, no sweep, no daemon.
watchme.enough: three live supersessions in which the scan's blind count was reported alongside its findings AND no boat riding a superseded intention reached a forward crossing without being refused. Three because a supersession of an intention with zero boats proves nothing about the interesting case, and the blind count earns trust only once it has been non-zero and acted on. EARLY STOP if the first supersession shows the refusal firing on a boat the scan had missed — that is the blindness being real, and it converts the child above from a chore into the next build.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the scan's output VERBATIM — findings and blind count together, because a scan reported as only what it found is the shape this node forbids
watchme.nexus: the harbor_master's own tree; the deprecation report is the consumer surface
watchme.consumer: the hand superseding the intention, who is deciding whether to proceed, and Akien, who owns whether a riding boat is ended or re-parented

intent_berth: none, because this node arose inside a design conversation on 2026-08-18 that walked up from a cgroup to the ownership graph; its durable referent is the sorted berth above and CairnCommons/slates/2026-08-18-the-heartbeat-is-the-managers-now.json.
